statement.p: B. Which of the following average values of f is larger?

static.solution:
A. The integral is the area above the x-axis minus the area below the x-axis. Thus, we can see that \int_{-3}^3 f(x)\,dx is about -6.5 + 1.75 = -4.75.
To determine which average value of f(x) is largest, we consider the areas \int_{-3}^{3} f(x) dx and \int_{0}^{3} f(x) dx. If the first (divided by six) is greater than the second (divided by 3), the average value over the first is larger than that over the second. Here, the interval 0 \le x \le 3 gives the largest average value.
